      "type": "SET_SETPOINT",

      "why": "KG evidence links obs_param_cstr_pressure_bar and PCV actuation to R_PIC; attempting to raise the valve opening setpoint may counteract a stuck-closed condition if the issue is partial degradation rather than complete blockage."
    },
    {
      "type": "SET_MODE",
      "target": "controller_R_PIC",
      "why": "If the loop is auto, switching to manual could allow direct override of the PCV position to increase opening, bypassing a degraded control path while diagnosing the valve state."
    }
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Evidence strongly suggests PCV-related fault; avoid actions that rely on a healthy PCV if the valve is actually stuck.",
    "If symptoms persist or safety interlocks are engaged (SIF_R_P_HH latched), follow SIF/override procedures before sustaining manual overrides."
  ],
  "kg_nodes": [
    "fault_h2_pcv_stuck_closed",
    "PCV-101",
    "R_PIC",
    "sym_pcv_command_actual_mismatch",
    "obs_param_cstr_pressure_bar",
    "PT-101",
    "PCV-101"
  ]
}
